Description: A theme-aware web component that groups the pin, minimize, maximize, restore and close controls of a window in one bar, and emits its own event for each event of a control.

template.description: The HTML template for the taskbar component.

div.bar.description: The surface that lays out the controls in a row or in a column.

pin-button.description: The control that pins and unpins.

visibility.description: Indicates whether the component is visible or hidden.

orientation.description: Indicates whether the controls are laid out side by side, in landscape, or one above the other, in portrait.

hide.description: Sets 'visibility' state to 'hidden' and hides the taskbar.

show.description: Sets 'visibility' state to 'visible' and shows the taskbar.

onhide.description: Dispatched when taskbar 'visibility' state changes from 'visible' to 'hidden'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new visibility state of the component.

onshow.description: Dispatched when taskbar 'visibility' state changes from 'hidden' to 'visible'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new visibility state of the component.

onpin.description: Dispatched each time the pin control reports that its status changed to 'pinned'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new status of the pin control.

onunpin.description: Dispatched each time the pin control reports that its status changed to 'unpinned'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new status of the pin control.

onminimize.description: Dispatched each time the minimize control reports that minimizing is requested.

onmaximize.description: Dispatched each time the maximize control reports that maximizing is requested.

onrestore.description: Dispatched each time the restore control reports that restoring is requested.

onclose.description: Dispatched each time the close control reports that closing is requested.

onpin.description: The pin control reports that it was pinned.

onunpin.description: The pin control reports that it was unpinned.

onminimize.description: The minimize control reports that minimizing is requested.

onmaximize.description: The maximize control reports that maximizing is requested.

onrestore.description: The restore control reports that restoring is requested.

onclose.description: The close control reports that closing is requested.
